title: Causal Edge Transport Reorders Turbulent Plume Evidence Before Bayesian Search
hook: Exact horizon-2 lookahead can lose to myopic search when it plans through a misordered likelihood field; a smaller intervention is to replace global sample comparison with causal transport over the evidence already available. The proposal adds no planning depth, learned model, new House, or new seed.
hook_shape_rationale: Counter-intuitive minimalism: relative to exact horizon-2 information gain, the candidate is strictly no larger on planning depth and uses only frozen M1/M2 fields plus the realized observation prefix, while targeting the upstream source-order metric that the 22/106 result implicates. A structural-reframe hook was also viable because arxiv:2605.13208v1 globally ranks accumulated concentrations, but it was rejected because the user-supplied failed-lookahead contrast gives a sharper admission test than redescribing temporal exchangeability as tacit.

gap_closure.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2605.13208v1, no retrieved work establishes whether candidate-source ordering remains valid when a single-UAV trajectory samples a turbulent plume whose observed-to-modeled relation changes across intermittent regimes rather than remaining globally monotone — stakes: a source can be ranked below a geometrically incompatible rival before accumulation, wasting the fixed flight budget and making conclusions from monotone-sensor evaluations fail to transfer to held-out GADEN houses.
gap_closure.how_closed: The gap is closed by reframing candidate support as a lexicographic monotone-transport attribution over causal observation/field edges, then using a pre-cost temporal-pairing intervention—not a permutation of already-scored values—to supply the companion's confound-isolating offline gate.

core_mechanism: For each causally available observation edge i=(t-1,t) in each existing completed run and the current prefix, let n_r be that run's edge count and form Delta y_i=y_t-y_{t-1}. For candidate s, compute g_{s,t}=log((Lsrc_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)/(Lcar_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)), where epsilon_machine is fixed to the machine epsilon of the frozen likelihood-storage dtype (IEEE-754 float64 by default), the dtype and value are hashed, and it is never swept. Before division, compute A_r=sum_i|Delta y_i| and B_{sr}=sum_i|Delta g_{s,i}|. A run is common-informative only when A_r>0 and B_{sr}>0 for every candidate in that comparison; otherwise exclude that run for every candidate. If no common-informative run remains, M3 is the identity. On each common-informative run form observation tokens (i/n_r,u_i,a_i), with u_i=sign(Delta y_i) and a_i=|Delta y_i|/A_r, and field tokens (i/n_r,v_{s,i},b_{s,i}), with v_{s,i}=sign(Delta g_{s,i}) and b_{s,i}=|Delta g_{s,i}|/B_{sr}. Thus both sides carry unit mass on common support: relative within-run transition magnitude is retained, while absolute total-variation scale is intentionally discarded. Define O_{sr} as the unique chronological noncrossing coupling returned by a cumulative-mass scan. Evaluate that fixed coupling by Cdir_{sr}, the transported mass joining opposite directions, and Ctime_{sr}, the transported normalized displacement |i/n_r-j/n_r|. Let T_s be the componentwise arithmetic mean of (Cdir_{sr},Ctime_{sr}) over the same common-informative runs for every candidate. Candidates are compared lexicographically by T_s: direction mismatch is the primary candidate-score coordinate and time displacement the secondary coordinate; direction is not separately optimized over arbitrary crossing couplings, and no scalar weight bridges the coordinates. Stable-sort candidates by ascending T_s, retaining baseline order on exact ties, then sort the current baseline likelihood-value multiset descending and assign those values in that candidate order before unchanged Bayesian accumulation and action scoring. This rank projection can change relative candidate evidence whenever the truth-blind order changes, but preserves the likelihood-value multiset exactly and uses no source truth or selected threshold. For the preregistered control, within each completed common-informative run cyclically shift each candidate's paired (v_{s,i},b_{s,i}) values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) while retaining time coordinates and observation tokens, then recompute O_s, T_s, and the rank projection. The shift can change an order-sensitive score but need not do so for every nonconstant sequence; delta_r=0 runs and score-invariant shifted runs are marked non-informative/control failures rather than counted as confirmation. Source identities remain sequestered until baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control candidate orders have all been frozen.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. On the frozen realized path, the true candidate's source-over-carrier field transitions retain temporally ordered local agreement with GADEN concentration transitions even when absolute observed-to-modeled levels are not globally monotone — untested — falsification target.
P2. On a common-informative run set, transporting independently normalized transition mass by the unique chronological noncrossing coupling preserves relative within-run timing and magnitude shape that global concentration ranks discard; it intentionally discards absolute total-variation scale. Direction mismatch is the primary coordinate when comparing candidate scores and time displacement the secondary coordinate; direction is not optimized over arbitrary crossing couplings — untested — falsification target.
P3. The existing source/carrier likelihood pair is an internal contrast with stable semantics under frozen M1/M2; no source truth is needed to compute g_{s,t}.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise. Samples come from an adaptively chosen, non-IID single-UAV path with intermittent censoring; the method conditions on the realized timestamps, positions, and causal run boundaries and does not assume that sampled edges are unbiased draws from a stationary plume.
ESTIMAND. At prefix k, T_s(k) is the componentwise mean, over the identical common-informative causally observed run prefixes, of the opposite-direction transported-mass fraction and normalized temporal displacement evaluated on the unique chronological noncrossing coupling between normalized observation-change mass and candidate-s normalized source-over-carrier-change mass. The offline evaluation estimand is the change in true-source pairwise ordering frequency over the fixed 106 H02/H03 comparisons after all truth-blind orders are frozen.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT:
The naive runnable version pools all observed and modeled values and ranks a candidate by global rank agreement or one pooled correlation. Branch (i): it silently assumes samples are exchangeable under one stationary monotone relation, which is false in the target setting when intermittent regimes and adaptive motion change that relation; Causal Edge Transport confronts this by making ordered transition atoms and their chronological noncrossing coupling the scored object rather than adding cosmetics to a pooled statistic. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: monotone transport and sequence alignment are textbook tools, but this instance couples adaptively sampled observation edges to paired source-versus-carrier field edges, must preserve the incumbent likelihood multiset at the Bayesian interface, and must expose a pairing-breaking no-truth null; that constrained object and interface are the domain-specific contribution rather than an off-the-shelf distance. The design deliberately avoids the occupied ancestral routes of global empirical ranks, covariance whitening, Huber residual clipping, CUSUM segmentation, and ABC tolerance selection.
BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE:
The anchor is kept as one deep gap because a separate correlation-regime or stationarity module is not required to run or falsify the ordering operator; the controlled diagnostic earns its seat only as the companion intervention on the same transport object. Windowed correlation, change-point segmentation, and learned calibration were rejected because they respectively regress to occupied covariance/CUSUM nodes or introduce tuning and access beyond the frozen fields. A likelihood-multiset interface is retained from the salvageable prior attempt, but the failed symmetric replication statistic and its invariant run permutation are replaced by a chronological pre-pairing construction and a null that can, but is not guaranteed to, alter its score; score invariance is reported as a control failure, not as confirming evidence.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Read the frozen M1/M2 source likelihood Lsrc_{s,t}, carrier likelihood Lcar_{s,t}, GADEN concentration y_t, timestamp, position, and existing causal run identifier for every candidate s on the realized prefix; lock and hash the likelihood-storage dtype and its machine epsilon, and output a schema-checked prefix table without source truth.
2. Within each run, let n_r be its edge count, compute adjacent Delta y_i and Delta g_{s,i}, and compute totals A_r=sum_i|Delta y_i| and B_{sr}=sum_i|Delta g_{s,i}| before any division. Mark the run common-informative only if A_r>0 and B_{sr}>0 for every candidate; exclude every other run for all candidates, and output identity if none remains.
3. On each common-informative run, construct ordered observation tokens (i/n_r,sign(Delta y_i),|Delta y_i|/A_r) and candidate field tokens (i/n_r,sign(Delta g_{s,i}),|Delta g_{s,i}|/B_{sr}), plus direction-mismatch and normalized time-displacement pair costs.
4. For every candidate and common-informative run, obtain the unique chronological noncrossing coupling O_{sr} by cumulative mass scanning and evaluate that fixed coupling as (Cdir_{sr},Ctime_{sr}); do not re-optimize direction mismatch over crossing couplings.
5. For every candidate, componentwise-average its per-run cost pairs over the identical common-informative run set to obtain T_s, then stable-sort candidates lexicographically by ascending T_s while preserving baseline order on exact ties; output the truth-blind candidate permutation.
6. Sort the current baseline likelihood values descending and assign them in the candidate order from step 5; output the exactly multiset-preserving M3 likelihood vector for the unchanged Bayesian accumulator and action selector.
7. In the offline gate only, cyclically shift each completed common-informative run's paired field (direction,mass) values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) while retaining time coordinates, rerun steps 3-6, and output the shifted-pairing control vector; mark delta_r=0 or aligned/shifted score-invariant runs as non-informative control outcomes.
8. Freeze hashes of the baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control vectors for all fixed H02/H03 comparisons, then let the sequestered evaluator reveal source identities and compute the preregistered downstream ordering metric.
falsification_prediction: Replay the fixed 106 H02/H03 comparisons with frozen M1/M2 and the realized paths under three truth-blind arms: myopic baseline, aligned Causal Edge Transport M3, and the half-run cyclic-shift control; freeze all candidate orders before the sequestered GADEN source identities are read. If the mechanism works, held-out true-source pairwise ordering win rate for aligned transport increases relative to myopic, without a preregistered numeric outcome bar. The single load-bearing variable is the aligned candidate-by-edge transport object O_s together with its lexicographic score T_s. As a negative-control intervention, shifting candidate-field token values before pair-cost construction must move the downstream true-source ordering win rate back toward or below myopic; failure of that return, or equality of every aligned and shifted T_s despite nonconstant inputs, falsifies the claimed temporal-pairing mechanism and blocks runtime integration.
compute_budget: 0.2 80GB-GPU-day equivalent for implementation checks and the full fixed 106-comparison replay; the transport and hashing path is CPU-bound, so no model training is required. $0 API cost for the full campaign.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: The abstract describes global empirical ranks of accumulated measured and modeled concentrations, whereas this candidate constructs an order-sensitive, magnitude-carrying monotone transport over causal observation/source-carrier edges and an explicit pre-pairing null.

The abstract compares an accumulated probabilistic gas-hit map with online dispersion simulations, whereas this candidate attributes each causal concentration-transition mass to candidate-specific source-over-carrier transitions before Bayesian accumulation without constructing a new map.

The abstract changes the action policy from myopic information gain to far-sighted reinforcement learning while retaining a fixed plume likelihood, whereas this candidate leaves planning unchanged and replaces the upstream candidate ordering delivered to it.

what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to preserve causal adjacency and magnitude, construct a candidate-specific ordered coupling between observation transitions and source-over-carrier field transitions, and falsify that coupling by breaking the pairings before recomputing the score rather than globally ranking accumulated values.
